## PopupBits working rails

These apply in every PopupBits repository. Anything more specific in the rest of
this file, or in `PROJECT.md` where one exists, wins over them.

**Never claim a command passed unless you ran it and saw it pass.** Say plainly
what you could not verify, in as much detail as what you could.

**Gates must be read from a file.** Redirect a test or analyze run to a file and
capture its exit code explicitly. Piping a gate into `tail` or `head` reports
the pipe's status, so a failing run looks green.

**Scripting.** Write tooling and throwaway scripts in Dart.

**Secrets stay out.** Never read, move, or commit keystores, `key.properties`,
`.env*`, service-account JSON, or any signing material, and never paste a secret
into a file, a log, or a commit message.

**Committing and pushing.** Commit only when asked, and commit only the paths
you changed — `git commit -- <path>`, never `git add -A`, which sweeps up work
that is not yours. Do not push unless you are asked to.

**Releases.** Publishing, signing and store submission follow one shared
pipeline across every app. Do not improvise them: use the
`popupbits-release-pipeline` skill, or ask for the release guide.

Shared Dart/Flutter components for PopupBits' Nepal small-business apps
(Sajilo Rent, Gaadidesk, Sandesh, Sambandha, Tipot receipts, client sites).

## Layout

| Path | What |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/nepal_kit` | Pure Dart core: BS dates, numbers/NPR/words/VAT, phones, address data, receipt PDF, SMS client, ne/en strings. No Flutter. |
| `packages/nepal_kit_flutter` | Widgets (BS picker, month calendar), receipt preview/print/share, Devanagari rasteriser, localizations. **`package:flutter/widgets.dart` only** — never import `flutter/material.dart` or `material_ui` here; consumer apps use either. |
| `example` | Flutter app showing every component (`?tab=receipt&lang=ne` on web). |
| `tool/gen_address_data.dart` | Regenerates `address_data.dart` from `tool/data/local-states-nepal`. |

A Dart pub workspace: run `flutter pub get` at the root.

The per-app adoption plan is private and lives in the popupbits hub at
`docs/nepal-kit-adoption.md`. This repository is public: keep client names,
real phone numbers and private-app internals out of code, tests and docs.

## Gates

Run each to a file and check its exit code (see the rails below):

```sh
cd packages/nepal_kit && dart analyze && dart test
cd packages/nepal_kit_flutter && flutter analyze && flutter test
cd example && flutter analyze && flutter test
```

## Rules specific to this repo

- **Calendar data is evidence, not opinion.** `bs_calendar_data.dart` is
  pinned by tests against known dates and an independent ahargana table.
  Never edit a month length without a source and a new test; extend the
  range only where several independent tables agree.
- **Money is integer paisa.** No `double` in money paths; rounding goes
  through `divideRounded` (halves away from zero).
- **Devanagari in PDFs goes through a `TextRasterizer`.** The `pdf` package
  cannot shape Devanagari; the plain-text fallback is for servers only.
- **Releases are tag-driven.** Public on GitHub (lohanidamodar/nepal-kit,
  MIT) and pub.dev. Bump the version and CHANGELOG, commit, then push a
  `nepal_kit-vX.Y.Z` or `nepal_kit_flutter-vX.Y.Z` tag; `.github/workflows/
  publish.yml` publishes. Never run `pub publish` by hand after 0.1.0, and
  only tag when asked.
